answer: Operator Liability Escrow: each registered agent wallet carries a per-identity escrow posted by its operator, replenished on every registration. A detected sybil cluster triggers a ripple charge that drains the escrow of the operator behind every linked wallet, not just the flagged one. Operators must then re-verify identity before any wallet can transact. The zephyr of low-cost registrations disappears: an attacker pays the full escrow per identity, and a single ridge of detection cascades cost across the entire operator's fleet.
